scope: Saved common-mask per-race score rows only; no new joins, model changes, inference, forecasts or tuning.
decomposition_rule: Per race: delta=FS6_score-FS5_score; cycle contribution=delta/N. Sum all fixed-mask contributions without exclusions. Positive means worse.
expected_D_share_rule: 0.5 + saved expected_margin/2, from conditional predictive expected shares; not logistic(mean logit).

units.shares_and_widths: D/(D+R) share units; multiply100 for percentage points

observed_interpretation: 2018: NM and DE account for more than the net CRPS worsening because the other23 races jointly improve. FS6 expected D shares move farther above the actual shares in both; central80/95 share intervals are slightly wider, not narrower.

2022: NV and PA dominate Brier/NLL worsening. FS6 expected D share and D-win probability decrease in both, while actual D shares exceed0.5. NV intervals widen slightly; PA intervals narrow slightly. Width change alone is not a common explanation.
The other21 races jointly offset the2022 NV/PA losses. WI, NC and OH provide the largest binary-score improvements. These offsets are included, not removed.

These are associations within saved forecasts and exact loss accounting. They do not identify the slope mechanism, respondent dependence, source causes or a repair. No exclusions, new joins or tuning are proposed.
decision_context: Root plans retainFS5/no default change; this bounded material-regression investigation does not develop or qualify another challenger.

validation.numerical_error_scope: Saved MCSEs condition on fixed historical banks; not electoral generalization intervals or causal attribution.
